home.practice_pouring_blurb: Take turns with rival pirates setting drinks down on one bar top. Each drink must suit its neighbours; fill a row or a column to serve it.
pouring.title: Pouring
pouring.how_to: Pick a drink from your hand, then tap a square to set it down. A drink must suit every drink beside it, up, down, left and right: each must share its glass or its brew. Fill a row or a column and you serve it: it scores, and every drink in it is taken away. Your rivals take their turns after yours, and they serve lines too.
pouring.how_to_keyboard: 1, 2 and 3 pick a drink. Arrows or WASD move the cursor on the bar; space or enter sets the drink down. X drinks the picked drink.
pouring.clean_note: A drink leaves your ring on its square for good. A square no drink has stood on is clean: the first ring on it scores, and lines served by a pour onto a clean square are worth double.
pouring.double_note: A row and a column served by one pour count together, for four times a line.
pouring.drink_note: Tap the picked drink again to down it instead: it scores its value, and pours nothing for the pirate after you. Down too many in a row and you are out cold for a turn. With nothing that fits, you must drink.
pouring.age_note: A drink that waits in your hand is worth more each turn, for a while.
pouring.special_note: Ice sets down on any empty square, and anything stands beside it. A rag wipes one drink off the bar; its ring stays.
pouring.hint_note: Practice rounds show a pour worth making when you pause.
pouring.stage.lines_intro: Set drinks down where they suit their neighbours, and fill a row or a column to serve it before a rival does.
pouring.stage.clean_intro: Serve a line with a pour onto a clean square for double. Save a clean square to close your lines.
pouring.stage.full_intro: Ice and rags come in the bag, and a drink is worth more the longer it waits.
pouring.legend_drinks: Every drink is a glass and a brew. A drink suits its neighbour when they share a glass or a brew.
pouring.legend_brews: Brews, each its own mark in the glass:
pouring.legend_ice: Ice. Sets down on any empty square, and anything stands beside it.
pouring.legend_rag: Rag. Wipes one drink off the bar. Its ring stays.
pouring.legend_ring: A ring under a square is the pirate who first set a drink there. A square with no ring is clean.

studio.preset.pouring_sharp_rivals: Sharp rivals: always their best pour
